## Summary

## Spec

<!--
For a change that people see or do: a vertical list of plain statements.
- Each rule, limit and edge case.
- What a screen reader says.
- What doesn't change.
Remove this section for a change that people don't see.
-->

## Release note

<!--
Deliver puts this in the release notes ("Release notes" in AGENTS.md). Write it in app text.
- Kind: new, improved, fixed, or none for a change that people don't see (tests, CI, docs).
- Highlight: yes for a change that people notice at once. It shows with its note as the title.
- Note: one line, 100 characters or fewer, of what people see or can do now. Empty for none.
- Picture: for a highlight only. The story step to show (1, 2...) or video. Empty for step 1.
- Replaces: the pull requests in the same release whose notes this note replaces (#219).
  Write the note to cover them too. Empty for none.
-->
Kind: none
Highlight: no
Note:
Picture:
Replaces:
